meta.title: Telegram
meta.description: Your Telegram account inside DeepSeek Harness. A paper-plane button opens an MTProto (GramJS) overlay from any section: QR sign-in (phone + code + 2FA as fallback), dialog list, message thread, composer, profile and a connection diagnostics view. The agent gets a telegram tool for reading dialogs, searching and sending messages.
